find_nearby_stations.description: List the public transport stops closest to a point, nearest first, each with how far away it is in metres. Feed it a phone's coordinates or a place looked up elsewhere to answer 'which stop do I walk to?'.
find_nearby_stations.name: find_nearby_stations

parameters.description: Latitude of the point to search around, between -90 and 90. Switzerland sits between about 45.8 and 47.8.
parameters.name: latitude

parameters.description: Longitude of the point to search around, between -180 and 180. Switzerland sits between about 5.9 and 10.5.
parameters.name: longitude

parameters.description: How many places to keep, from 1 to 50. Leave empty to keep every match the timetable returns.
parameters.name: max_results

get_journey_details.description: Break one journey down leg by leg: every train, bus, boat or walk it is made of, with the line, the direction, the platforms, the times, and every stop each leg calls at. Use 'Which connection' to detail a later option from the same search.
get_journey_details.display_str_template: Get Swiss journey details from {0} to {1}.
get_journey_details.name: get_journey_details

parameters.description: Where the journey starts: a stop name ('Lausanne', 'Zürich, Bahnhofstrasse'), a full address, or the station id returned by 'Search places'.
parameters.name: from_location

parameters.description: Where the journey ends: a stop name, an address, or a station id.
parameters.name: to_location

parameters.description: When to travel. Leave empty to search from now. Also accepts Swiss local text from an earlier step, such as '2026-03-25 17:30', '2026-03-25' or '17:30'.
parameters.name: departure_time

parameters.description: Turn on to search for journeys that arrive by the given time instead of leaving after it. Off by default.
parameters.display_name: Treat the time as the arrival time
parameters.name: is_arrival_time

parameters.description: Stops the journey must pass through, at most five. Accepts a list or a comma-separated string.
parameters.name: via

parameters.description: Only use these means of transport. Leave empty for all of them.
parameters.name: transportations

parameters.description: Which journey of the search to detail, counting from 0 for the first one. Defaults to 0.
parameters.name: connection_index

get_last_connection.description: Find the latest journey that still gets you there by a given time (the last train home). Searches by arrival time, drops anything that would arrive late, and returns the one that leaves last, so you also learn the time to leave by.
get_last_connection.display_str_template: Get the last Swiss connection from {0} to {1}.
get_last_connection.name: get_last_connection

parameters.description: Where the journey starts: a stop name ('Lausanne', 'Zürich, Bahnhofstrasse'), a full address, or the station id returned by 'Search places'.
parameters.name: from_location

parameters.description: Where the journey ends: a stop name, an address, or a station id.
parameters.name: to_location

parameters.description: The time you need to be there. A date on its own means the end of that day. Also accepts Swiss local text such as '2026-03-25 23:30' or '23:30'.
parameters.name: arrive_by

parameters.description: Stops the journey must pass through, at most five. Accepts a list or a comma-separated string.
parameters.name: via

parameters.description: Only use these means of transport. Leave empty for all of them.
parameters.name: transportations

get_next_departure.description: Answer 'when is the next one?' for a trip: the next journey leaving now from one place to another, with how many minutes away it is, its platform, any delay, and how long it takes. Returns 'found: false' when nothing more runs today rather than failing the step.
get_next_departure.display_str_template: Get the next Swiss connection from {0} to {1}.
get_next_departure.name: get_next_departure

parameters.description: Where the journey starts: a stop name ('Lausanne', 'Zürich, Bahnhofstrasse'), a full address, or the station id returned by 'Search places'.
parameters.name: from_location

parameters.description: Where the journey ends: a stop name, an address, or a station id.
parameters.name: to_location

parameters.description: Stops the journey must pass through, at most five. Accepts a list or a comma-separated string.
parameters.name: via

parameters.description: Only use these means of transport. Leave empty for all of them.
parameters.name: transportations

get_station_arrivals.description: Read a stop's arrival board: the next services pulling in, each with its line, where it came from, the platform, the time and any delay (the board to check before meeting someone off a train).
get_station_arrivals.name: get_station_arrivals

parameters.description: The stop whose board to read, by name: 'Aarau', 'Zürich HB', 'Luzern, Bahnhof'. Give this or a stop id; if you give both, the id wins.
parameters.name: station

parameters.description: The stop whose board to read, by id: the 'id' of a result from 'Search places' or 'Find nearby stops'. Takes precedence over the stop name.
parameters.name: station_id

parameters.description: Show the board as it stands at this moment. Leave empty for now. Also accepts Swiss local text such as '2026-03-25 17:30' or '17:30'.
parameters.name: when

parameters.description: Only use these means of transport. Leave empty for all of them.
parameters.name: transportations

parameters.description: How many services to list, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 10. This is a soft limit: services leaving in the same minute as the last one are included too.
parameters.name: limit

get_station_departures.description: Read a stop's departure board: the next services leaving, each with its line, where it is heading, the platform, the time and any delay. Name the stop or give its id, and set a time to read the board as it will stand later.
get_station_departures.name: get_station_departures

parameters.description: The stop whose board to read, by name: 'Aarau', 'Zürich HB', 'Luzern, Bahnhof'. Give this or a stop id; if you give both, the id wins.
parameters.name: station

parameters.description: The stop whose board to read, by id: the 'id' of a result from 'Search places' or 'Find nearby stops'. Takes precedence over the stop name.
parameters.name: station_id

parameters.description: Show the board as it stands at this moment. Leave empty for now. Also accepts Swiss local text such as '2026-03-25 17:30' or '17:30'.
parameters.name: when

parameters.description: Only use these means of transport. Leave empty for all of them.
parameters.name: transportations

parameters.description: How many services to list, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 10. This is a soft limit: services leaving in the same minute as the last one are included too.
parameters.name: limit

search_connections.description: Plan a journey between two places on the Swiss timetable. Each result carries the departure and arrival times, platforms, how long it takes, how many changes it needs, which lines it uses and any delay reported right now. Search from a departure time or, with 'Treat the time as the arrival time', backwards from when you need to be there.
search_connections.name: search_connections

parameters.description: Where the journey starts: a stop name ('Lausanne', 'Zürich, Bahnhofstrasse'), a full address, or the station id returned by 'Search places'.
parameters.name: from_location

parameters.description: Where the journey ends: a stop name, an address, or a station id.
parameters.name: to_location

parameters.description: Stops the journey must pass through, at most five. Accepts a list or a comma-separated string.
parameters.name: via

parameters.description: When to travel. Leave empty to search from now. Also accepts Swiss local text from an earlier step, such as '2026-03-25 17:30', '2026-03-25' or '17:30'.
parameters.name: departure_time

parameters.description: Turn on to search for journeys that arrive by the given time instead of leaving after it. Off by default.
parameters.display_name: Treat the time as the arrival time
parameters.name: is_arrival_time

parameters.description: Only use these means of transport. Leave empty for all of them.
parameters.name: transportations

parameters.description: How many journeys to return, from 1 to 16. Journeys leaving at the same minute count as one. Defaults to the API's own handful.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Which page of journeys to return, 0 to 3. Page 0 is the first. Feed the 'next_page' value from a previous run back in here to look further ahead.
parameters.name: page

search_locations.description: Find Swiss stations, stops, points of interest and addresses by name, best match first. Use it to turn 'Basel' into the exact stop name and id the other actions take, and to get a place's coordinates.
search_locations.name: search_locations

parameters.description: The place to look for. A partial name works: 'Basel' matches Basel SBB, Basel Bad Bf and the rest.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Narrow the search to one kind of place. Defaults to everything.
parameters.name: location_type

parameters.description: How many places to keep, from 1 to 50. Leave empty to keep every match the timetable returns.
parameters.name: max_results

description: Plan journeys on Switzerland's public transport through the keyless Opendata.ch API: search trains, trams, buses, boats and cable cars between any two places, read a stop's live departure or arrival board with delays and platforms, find the stops nearest a point, and break a journey down leg by leg. No account or API key is required.
